newsitem.title: USA: Electroscope sees lower than expected Q2.
newsitem.headline: Electroscope sees lower than expected Q2.

text.p: Electroscope Inc said Friday it expects revenues of about $359,000 for its second quarter ended September 30, about 30 percent below second quarter estimates by securities analysts who follow the company.
The company said earnings are expected to be down during the second quarter to a loss of about $0.10 per share versus estimates of a loss of $0.07 per share by securities analysts.
The company said these projected results are due to lower-than-expected shipments in the second quarter for Electroscope's Electroshield Monitoring System.
